observed_result: The compare protocol was written and its SHA-256 recorded before the matrix was run, and it was not edited afterwards. (1) Named sets. Each is the intersection of the selectors the protocol declares, and the framework attaches no meaning to the name. alin = class == "ALIN": 24 nodes, indices 350..132605, node hash a507a3db1b1572b388b1ca8a32b1707c3d679ba59a41cab2aa3a70d5ce03c926. descending_neuron = superclass == "descending_neuron": 1,314 nodes, indices 0..163544, node hash 9a43073e6c0af3b6b74beddda0fe8f39963f488414beeb42535f63528103e191. vnc_motor = superclass == "vnc_motor": 708 nodes, indices 111304..164969, node hash b48e2ee959d412d45b135611cec2d330fb591a164bca5e291d98a13da94af52b. The node hash is the SHA-256 of the ascending node indices as little-endian uint32, so two reports can be compared without the graph. These are the same three sets NAT-01 and NAT-02 probed, and alin is also the injected set: the pulse enters exactly those 24 neurons. (2) Metrics, as evaluated on the original wiring (cell 0). Every result carries the numerator and the denominator the definition divides plus the basis sentence the report writes out. alin_spike_fraction (spike_fraction, window [10,300)): 24/24 = 1, basis "nodes of alin that spiked at least once in steps [10,300) over the 24 nodes the set resolved to". alin_mean_rate (mean_rate, [30,300)): 1,597/(24 x 270) = 1597/6480 = 0.24645061728395062, basis "spike events of alin in steps [30,300) over 24 nodes times 270 steps". alin_latency (latency_to_first_spike, [10,300)): first spike step 10 minus window start 10 = 0, basis "first step in [10,300) at which any node of alin spiked, minus the window start; undefined when the set stayed silent". alin_activity_ratio (activity_ratio_vs_baseline, window [30,300), baseline [10,30)): 0.24645061728395062/0.3375 = 0.7302240512117055, basis "mean_rate of alin in steps [30,300) over its mean_rate in the baseline steps [10,30); undefined when the baseline rate is zero". descending_neuron_spike_fraction: 741/1314 = 0.5639269406392694. descending_neuron_mean_rate: 31,186/(1314 x 270) = 31186/354780 = 0.08790236202717176. descending_neuron_latency: 23 - 10 = 13 steps. descending_neuron_activity_ratio: 0.08790236202717176/0.0015601217656012177 = 56.34327009936766. vnc_motor_spike_fraction: 424/708 = 0.5988700564971752. vnc_motor_mean_rate: 14,535/(708 x 270) = 14535/191160 = 0.07603578154425612. vnc_motor_latency: 31 - 10 = 21 steps. vnc_motor_activity_ratio: numerator 0.07603578154425612, denominator 0, defined false. That last one is the rule working as declared: vnc_motor produced no spike at all during the baseline steps [10,30), so the ratio has no value and the report says undefined instead of writing zero. (3) Thresholds. Five were declared before the run and every one of them is reported with its declared operator and value next to the observation. alin_spike_fraction >= 0.5, observed 1, pass. descending_neuron_spike_fraction >= 0.1, observed 0.5639269406392694, pass. vnc_motor_spike_fraction >= 0.1, observed 0.5988700564971752, pass. descending_neuron_latency < 100, observed 13, pass. vnc_motor_latency < 150, observed 21, pass. All five also pass in all nine null model cells, which is the result that matters most for reading them: descending_neuron_spike_fraction ranges 0.5889830508474576 to 0.9535768645357686 and vnc_motor_latency 5 to 7 steps across the nine null cells, so these thresholds do not separate the real wiring from a rewired or reshuffled one and must not be read as if they did. The threshold results did not change the exit status, which was 0. (4) What a pass means. A pass means only "under this rule the set's metric reached the declared value". It is not evidence that the set has a function, that the network performed a behaviour, or that the wiring caused the value: the same rule passes on every null model here. An undefined metric always fails its threshold and records reason "undefined"; no threshold in this protocol pointed at the one undefined metric, so no such fail appears in this report, and the case is covered by the fixture tests instead.
assumption_statement: The thresholds and the windows are arbitrary and were fixed before the run. The five threshold values (spike fractions 0.5, 0.1 and 0.1; latencies below 100 and 150 steps) are engineering choices with no biological derivation; they were written into evidence/NAT-03/compare-fullgraph-derived-lif.json, whose SHA-256 de8319fc1887f505c7b9c24700446d14f222ef56834b40d711989487b305ba9a was recorded before the matrix started, and they were not adjusted after the numbers came back. The windows are equally arbitrary: [10,300) begins at the pulse onset, [30,300) begins when the pulse ends, and the baseline [10,30) is the pulse window itself, because nothing is injected before step 10 and any earlier baseline would be zero by construction, which would make every activity ratio undefined rather than informative. Using the stimulus window as the baseline means activity_ratio_vs_baseline compares the free-running phase against the driven phase, not against a resting state, and the numbers must be read that way. The set names are the user's: class ALIN, superclass descending_neuron and superclass vnc_motor are annotation values in the MaleCNS v1.0 release, and this record makes no claim that any of them is a behavioural unit. The run itself rests on the same assumptions as NAT-03: parameter_source derived_release/v1, rule-derived signs from predicted transmitter probabilities under the rules file f9474a1be70ea2d008ff842311bd31de50d329eccf53a15d59a4b5b31c2566d0, unknown_sign exclude for the 2,754,056 unknown edges, weight_scale 21.6, uniform bias, log_tau and theta_raw, zero delays, and the declared LIF engineering settings. None of that is a biological parameter set.

limitations: A pass says only that the metric reached the declared value under the declared rule. Every one of the five thresholds also passes in all nine null model cells, so none of them distinguishes the real wiring here; reading a pass as evidence about the wiring or about behaviour would be wrong.

The thresholds were never tightened or loosened, which also means they were never calibrated: they were guesses made before any whole-brain number existed, and the matrix shows most of them were loose.
One protocol, one stimulus, one core and one machine. The same sets read out on the continuous core are evidence/NAT-05/.

activity_ratio_vs_baseline uses the pulse window as its baseline, so it is a ratio of free-running to driven activity, not to rest. vnc_motor had no baseline spike at all, which is why its ratio is undefined on the original wiring.
The sets are annotation values only. No selector combines fields here, and no set was checked against any independent definition of the population it names.
Each cell was executed once; wall time and resident set size are single samples from a shared machine.
